x-shillinq-fragment.description: ADR-037 register fragment for the bookkeeping-bank-reconciliation capability — declares the BankReconciliation (session) and BankReconciliationMatch (pairing) schemas with lifecycle, RBAC and aggregations. Restores Tasks 1-5 / hydra-build #50 after the schemas were dropped during a sibling union-merge; the BankReconciliationGuard (lib/Guard/BankReconciliationGuard.php) and its 10 unit tests already reference these slugs. Per ADR-031 derived monetary fields (reconciledBalance, variance) are server-authoritative — recomputed in integer cents by the guard, never trusted from the client.

BankReconciliation.title: Bank Reconciliation
BankReconciliation.description: One bank-account reconciliation session for a fiscal period. Tracks statement opening/closing balance, the server-recomputed reconciled balance, the residual variance, and an auditable status lifecycle (draft → in-progress → reconciled → archived). Per REQ-BBR-001/005/006. All monetary fields are stored as EUR with 2-decimal precision; reconciledBalance and variance are server-authoritative — recomputed by BankReconciliationGuard in integer cents and never trusted from the client.

bankAccountId.description: FK to the bank account being reconciled. A plain reference string; the bank-account register is owned by a separate spec (bookkeeping-bank-connectors) and only consumed here.
bankAccountId.title: Bank Account ID

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this reconciliation. Scopes per-tenant isolation for IDOR-safe queries per ADR-005.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

statementStartDate.description: First date on the bank statement.
statementStartDate.title: Statement Start Date

statementEndDate.description: Last date on the bank statement. Must be on or after statementStartDate (REQ-BBR-001 validation).
statementEndDate.title: Statement End Date

openingBalance.description: Balance at statement start, taken from the bank statement (EUR, 2 decimals). Operator-supplied.
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

closingBalance.description: Balance at statement end, taken from the bank statement (EUR, 2 decimals). Operator-supplied.
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

reconciledBalance.description: Derived: openingBalance + sum(approved match amounts). Server-authoritative — recomputed by BankReconciliationGuard::recalculateBalance in integer cents on every match change; never accepted from the client (REQ-BBR-005).
reconciledBalance.title: Reconciled Balance

variance.description: Derived: closingBalance − reconciledBalance. Server-authoritative; recomputed alongside reconciledBalance (REQ-BBR-005).
variance.title: Variance

unmatchedBankCount.description: Count of bank transactions without an approved journal match. Server-recomputed.
unmatchedBankCount.title: Unmatched Bank Count

unmatchedJournalCount.description: Count of journal entries without an approved bank match. Server-recomputed.
unmatchedJournalCount.title: Unmatched Journal Count

status.description: Lifecycle state. Driven by x-openregister-lifecycle; do not set directly to reconciled/archived — use the approve/archive transitions (REQ-BBR-006/009).
status.title: Status

approvedBy.description: User ID of the operator who approved the reconciliation. Set by the approve transition.
approvedBy.title: Approved By

approvedAt.description: Timestamp of approval. Set by the approve transition.
approvedAt.title: Approved At

varianceReason.description: Operator-documented explanation of a non-zero variance, captured at approval for the audit trail (REQ-BBR-006).
varianceReason.example: Bank charged €5.00 monthly fee (posted 2026-06-01, not yet journaled).
varianceReason.title: Variance Reason

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Session created; statement not yet imported. Editable.

in-progress.label: In progress
in-progress.description: Statement imported and auto-matching has run; operator is resolving exceptions. Editable.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Approved and locked for audit. Immutable — no further match changes (REQ-BBR-006); corrections require a new session.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Closed and moved to the archive view. Queryable for audit, not editable (REQ-BBR-009).

startReconciling.label: Start reconciling
startReconciling.description: Statement imported and auto-matching has run.

approve.label: Approve reconciliation
approve.description: Lock the reconciliation for audit. All pending-review matches must be resolved first; reconciledBalance and variance are recomputed server-side before locking (REQ-BBR-006).

approveFromDraft.label: Approve reconciliation
approveFromDraft.description: Direct approval for a trivially-empty statement; same resolved-matches precondition applies.

archive.label: Archive reconciliation
archive.description: Move the reconciled session to the archive view (REQ-BBR-009).

countByStatus.description: Number of reconciliation sessions per lifecycle status, for the index status filter and dashboard.

BankReconciliationMatch.title: Bank Reconciliation Match
BankReconciliationMatch.description: One paired transaction: a bank-statement line matched to a journal entry (APTransaction, GLLine, or Payment). Auto-matching is deterministic by amount + date ± reference; ambiguous and orphaned items are flagged pending-review for operator resolution. Every decision is timestamped and attributed (REQ-BBR-002/003/004/008). The bank transaction is NOT embedded as a full object — only a reference key + cached amount are stored (design D3).

bankTransactionRef.description: Deduplicating bank-transaction key: {bankAccountId}#{statementDate}#{amount}#{externalId}. Stable across re-imports of the same statement.
bankTransactionRef.title: Bank Transaction Ref

bankTransactionAmount.description: Amount from the bank statement, cached for display and for the reconciledBalance recomputation (EUR, 2 decimals).
bankTransactionAmount.title: Bank Transaction Amount

journalEntryId.description: FK to the matched journal entry (APTransaction, GLLine, or Payment). Null when unmatched/orphaned.
journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

journalEntryDescription.description: Cached description of the matched journal entry for display.
journalEntryDescription.title: Journal Entry Description

matchType.description: Match lifecycle state. Only approved matches contribute to reconciledBalance (REQ-BBR-005).
matchType.title: Match Type

confidenceScore.description: Auto-match confidence 0–100 (+100 exact amount, +20 reference found, −10 per day past deadline). ≥70 = auto-matched; 30–69 = pending-review; <30 = orphaned (journalEntryId null).
confidenceScore.title: Confidence Score

operatorNotes.example: Matched by invoice reference in memo field.
operatorNotes.title: Operator Notes

createdBy.description: User ID of the creator, or 'system-auto-match' for engine-created matches.
createdBy.title: Created By

approvedAt.description: When the operator approved this match.
approvedAt.title: Approved At

auto-matched.label: Auto-matched
auto-matched.description: Created by the auto-matching engine with confidence ≥70.

pending-review.label: Pending review
pending-review.description: Ambiguous (confidence 30–69) or orphaned; awaits operator decision.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Operator-rejected; journalEntryId cleared. Remains in the variance report.

approvePending.label: Approve match
approvePending.description: Operator pairs a pending match and approves it (REQ-BBR-003).

rejectFromPending.label: Reject match
rejectFromPending.description: Operator documents and rejects an orphaned/ambiguous item (REQ-BBR-004).

rejectFromAuto.label: Reject match
rejectFromAuto.description: Operator overrides an auto-match as incorrect.

unmatch.label: Unmatch
unmatch.description: Revert an approved match for re-review (REQ-BBR-008). Blocked when the parent reconciliation is locked.

approvedAmountTotal.description: Sum of approved match amounts per reconciliation, used as the declarative basis for reconciledBalance = openingBalance + this sum (REQ-BBR-005). The cross-period balance write itself is performed by BankReconciliationGuard per ADR-031 Risk-3.

countByType.description: Number of matches per matchType, for the detail-page match summary.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Bank Reconciliation Match is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).
